subject: Follow-up on recent purchase
text: Hello, I hope you are well. I am following up on a purchase I made with your team two days ago, because I have not yet received a confirmation email or an expected service appointment. The item was ordered online after I spoke with a representative about installation timing, and I was told the next step would be scheduled within 48 hours. I would be grateful if you could check whether the order was recorded under my account details and let me know if any further information is needed from me. A brief update would be very helpful, as I am trying to organize my schedule for next week. Thank you for your time, and I appreciate your help. I can provide the order number whenever it is convenient.
